50367080.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to N-terminal His6-tagged pVHL (54 to 213 amino acids) (unknown origin) expressed in Escherichia coli BL21 (DE3) by isothermal titration calorimetry

original_paragraph.Experimental Section - ITC Measurements: Isothermal titration calorimetry (ITC) experiments were performed on a MicroCal iTC200 instrument (Malvern Instruments, Worcestershire, U.K.) at 25 °C. The pVHL protein (54–213) was dialyzed against 20 mM HEPES, 100 mM NaCl, 1 mM DTT, pH 7.5, and concentrated to 100 μM. Ligands were dissolved in the same buffer to a concentration of 1–2 mM. The protein was loaded into the sample cell (200 μL), and the ligand was loaded into the syringe (250 μL). Titrations consisted of 20 injections of 2 μL each, spaced 180 s apart, with a stirring speed of 300 rpm. The heat of dilution was determined by titrating the ligand into buffer alone and subtracted from the raw data. Data were analyzed using Origin 7.0 software (MicroCal) with a one-site binding model. The reported Kd values are the average of at least two independent experiments.

assay_conditions.buffer_composition: 20 mM HEPES, 100 mM NaCl, 1 mM DTT
assay_conditions.control_method: Titration of ligand into buffer alone and subtracted from the raw data
